title: It's not the best
text: It's not the best. I could not afford the now expensive one so I bought this one because it was cheap.  You get what you pay for.

details.Specific instructions for use: Stick & Upright & Handheld & Cordless Vacuum Cleaner, Cyclonic, HEPA Filtration, Lightweight, Pet Hair, Portable, Washable Filter, Battery Powered, Bagless
details.Care instructions: ⚠️The suction power of cordless vacuum is weaken? 👉1. Check whether the battery needs charging. 👉2. Check if the dustbin, strainer or filters is full of dust. ❤️Please empty the dustbin, wash the strainer and mesh filter with cool water, and clean the HEPA filter with the cleanging gadget, replace the filter if necessary. 👉3. Check if the filters were installed correctly. 👉4. Check if there is any blockage in tube, or roller brush is tangled by hair.
details.Warranty Description: ❤️12-month worry-free warranty service and professional customer service, you can contact us to extend to 24-month warranty. We provide accessories replacement service.
